note: Which parts each breed uses (decision 131, docs/PARTS.md). Per kind: 'offer' (variants customers may choose; the shared library's or the breed's own), 'default'. Per offered variant: 'stretch' [x, y, z] (null: the size guess). Per torso variant: 'presets', the shape choices, the first 'default'; each a 'stretch' (null: the variant's) and 'sockets': per slot {'translate': [x, y, z] mm, 'rotate': [x, y, z] degrees}. 'sitting': the hind leg variant the sitting pose swaps in. Studio seeds a breed's kit from its entry; scripts/make_breed_parts.py only adds breeds.
